svg.title: Figure 02 · Quote uncertainty amplified by inversion
svg.desc: Forward 100, discount factor 1, volatility 20%; first-order IV half-width is 0.02 divided by vega. Values above 2.5 volatility points are clipped visually and excluded from the coordinate readout.
